title: Read a sensor through a simulated SPI bus
description: Implement uint16_t read_sensor(void) using the functions in sensor.h.
prompt:
Implement uint16_t read_sensor(void) using the functions in sensor.h.
Assert chip select with chip_select(1), send command 0x80, clock the high and low result bytes by sending two zero bytes, then deassert chip select with chip_select(0). Discard the response to the command. Return the big-endian 16-bit sample.
constraints: Exactly three transfers while chip select is asserted.
The bus is synchronous and infallible for this exercise.
This simulated transaction log does not test electrical timing or SPI mode.

tests.name: Typical sample
Zero sample
Full-scale sample

rubric: Respect the stated contract and bounds.
Explain integer widths, ownership, and relevant edge cases.
Separate host-test evidence from hardware guarantees.
follow_ups: Which boundary conditions would you test on the target?
What changes if the function is called from an ISR?
hints: Write down the boundary cases before choosing an implementation.
Use explicit integer widths and keep intermediate values in range.
